title: SPECIAL: Simon Kold Discusses His Book, On the Hunt for Great Companies
summary: Enjoy authentic, unscripted discussion, featuring Chris Bloomstran of Semper Augustus Investments Group, Phil Ordway of Anabatic Investment Partners, Elliot Turner of RGA Investment Advisors, and other thought-leading investors.
